Theme

Household, washing & chores · Kitchen, meals & drinks

fan noun

also electric fan, fan oven, fan (verb)

classical

Traupman 313
Ter. Eun. 3.5.47, as cited by Lewis & Short: cape hoc flābellum, et ventulum huic sīc facitō
Ter. Eun. 595

flābellum, flābellī n.

noun, second declension

In an oven, the fan.

Other words

  • māchina ventigena — electric fan

    also used · modern · Traupman 123; Traupman 309

  • ventilō, ventilāre, ventilāvī, ventilātum — fan (verb)

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 313

Examples

  • Cape hoc flābellum, et ventulum mihi facitō.

    Take this fan and make me a little breeze (after Terence).composed

  • Sī furnus tuus flābellō āëra calidum circumagit, vīgintī gradūs dētrahitō.

    If your oven has a fan that circulates hot air, take off twenty degrees.Culīna Theodōrī

  • māchinula ventigena

    an electric fanTraupman 313

See also air conditioning.
